caption:
Worried about money? Read what Allah says about giving

Provision is in Allah's hands: He extends it or restricts it for whom He wills. Whatever you spend in charity, He will compensate for it, for He is the Best of Providers.

Surah Saba 34:39

Give one small sadaqah before you sleep tonight.

#rizq #sadaqah #surahsaba #muslimhabits

Recitation: Mahmoud Khalil Al-Husary
alt_text: Say, “My Lord extends provision to whom He wills of His slaves or restricts it. Whatever you spend in charity, He will compensate for it, for He is the Best of Providers.” (Surah Saba 34:39)
theme: rizq and charity / Allah is the Best of Providers
